manage.blocks.action.kindHelp:
A link opens the selected page or address.
Join the event opens registration only when it is available to the visitor.
manage.blocks.action.positionHelp:
Button placement in the action block.
Left — by the section's left edge.
Center — in the middle of the section.
Right — by the right edge.
On narrow screens buttons may wrap.
manage.blocks.anchor.fromHeadingTooltip: Create an anchor from the block heading
manage.blocks.anchor.help:
The block's address for links.
• On this page — #anchor.
• From other pages — /page-address#anchor.
Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens. Must be unique on the page.
manage.blocks.anchor.invalid: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, up to {max} characters.
manage.blocks.anchor.label: Anchor
manage.blocks.anchor.taken: This anchor is already used on this page.
manage.blocks.banner.captionPositionHelp:
Aligns the caption over the photo.
Pick the side where it doesn't cover an important part of the image.
manage.blocks.banner.customHelp: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 5 MB. Drop a file here or choose one from your device. The image is shown only in this banner.
manage.blocks.banner.imageHelp:
The image source for this block.
• Event cover — reuses the file from the “General” section.
• Separate image — a file just for this banner.
Changing the banner does not change the event cover.
manage.blocks.banner.marginsHelp:
How the banner sits in the section.
• No margins — the banner reaches the section edges.
• Framed — the banner has padding and rounded corners.
The slider below sets the actual width.
manage.blocks.banner.widthHelp: A share of the page width. The image height scales with its own proportions. On narrow screens the banner takes the full available width.
manage.blocks.countdown.customHelp:
Enter a fixed date and time.
The time is entered in your local time zone and saved as an exact moment.
manage.blocks.countdown.layoutHelp: Place the explanation to the left of the countdown or center the whole section.
manage.blocks.countdown.scheduleDateHelp:
Pick a moment from the “Publishing and time” section.
The countdown updates if that moment changes in the schedule.
manage.blocks.countdown.sizeHelp: Large suits a regular section; extra large makes the numbers stand out more.
manage.blocks.countdown.sourceHelp:
Choose the moment to count down to.
• From the schedule — the date follows the event settings.
• Custom date and time — a fixed moment independent of the schedule.
manage.blocks.countdown.surfaceHelp: No frame — the section flows with the page. Framed — the countdown is highlighted inside the section, like in the previous home page look.
manage.blocks.countdown.textHelp:
An explanation under the countdown heading.
The field can be left empty.
manage.blocks.countdown.titleHelp:
A heading next to the countdown, or above it in the centered layout.
The field can be left empty.
manage.blocks.countdown.verticalHelp:
Placement of the left part relative to the countdown on the right.
Top — by the top edge.
Center — in the middle.
Bottom — by the bottom edge.
On narrow screens the parts stack.
manage.blocks.cta.styleHelp: Plain uses the page background, branded uses the event color.
manage.blocks.cta.textHelp:
A short text under the action block heading.
The field can be left empty.
manage.blocks.cta.titleHelp:
An optional heading above the buttons.
You can keep just the registration button.
manage.blocks.delete.tooltip: Delete the block. You can restore it for a few seconds.
manage.blocks.divider.lineHelp: Show a thin divider line in the middle of the gap.
manage.blocks.divider.spacingHelp: By default blocks follow each other without gaps. Add a divider between them to set a small, medium or large gap.
manage.blocks.doc.tocTitleHelp: The caption of the section list to the right of the text.
manage.blocks.drag.tooltip: Drag the block: a new spot opens in the list right away. With a keyboard, use the arrows.
manage.blocks.facts.layoutHelp:
How to arrange labels and values.
• Strip — facts in several columns, larger values.
• Rows — label on the left, value on the right. On narrow screens they stack.
manage.blocks.faq.openItemHelp:
Which answer is visible when the page first opens.
Participants can open and close other questions themselves.
manage.blocks.faq.question: Question {n}
manage.blocks.faq.subHelp:
An optional short text before the question list.
Shown even without a heading.
manage.blocks.faq.titleHelp:
Title of the question list.
Shown above the explanation and answers.
The field can be left empty.
manage.blocks.field.heading: Heading
manage.blocks.field.label: Label
manage.blocks.field.title: Title

• You can insert the event tag into the path.
manage.blocks.help.actionLabel: Text of the block's main button.
manage.blocks.help.by: The organizer line above the event name.
manage.blocks.help.kicker: A short overline before the event name.
manage.blocks.help.label: The heading separates the content that follows on the page.
manage.blocks.help.note: A small note under the hero actions.
manage.blocks.help.secondaryActionHref:

• An internal path starts with /.
• An external link must start with https://.
manage.blocks.help.secondaryActionLabel:
Text of the secondary button.

manage.blocks.help.sub: A short description under the block heading.
manage.blocks.help.text: An explanation next to the button or countdown.
manage.blocks.help.title:
Block title.
• In a banner it is shown over the image.
• In a hero it becomes the page's main heading.
manage.blocks.help.tocTitle:
The section navigation caption.
• On wide screens the contents sit to the right of the text.
• On narrow screens they move above the text.
manage.blocks.hero.compositionHelp:
Placement of facts, countdown and actions.
• Two zones — on wide screens facts on the left, countdown on the right. On narrow screens they stack.
• Centered — all content aligned on the central axis.
manage.blocks.hero.sizeHelp:
The size of the countdown numbers.
• Large — noticeable next to other content.
• Extra large — the section's main accent.
manage.blocks.hero.styleHelp: Branded uses the event's main color; plain uses the page background.
manage.blocks.hideAfter.help:
If on, the block disappears when the countdown reaches zero.
If off, the block stays with zeros.
manage.blocks.hideAfter.label: After it ends

The countdown appears at the chosen moment.
The time is saved with your time zone.
manage.blocks.showFrom.eventDateHelp:
Pick a date and time from the event schedule.
The countdown appears when that moment comes.

manage.blocks.text.widthHelp:
Sets the maximum content width.
• For reading — shorter lines, comfortable for long text.
• Full width — for tables and wide content.
manage.blocks.timeline.customFormatHelp:
Example: dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss.
Text in square brackets is shown as is, e.g. [at] HH:mm.
manage.blocks.timeline.customHelp:
A fixed date and time for this schedule item.
Set the date before changing the time.
manage.blocks.timeline.formatHelp:
Choose how the date and time look in this item.
A custom format uses: dd — day, MM — month, yyyy — year, HH — hours, mm — minutes, ss — seconds.
manage.blocks.timeline.layoutHelp:
How to show schedule stages.
• Cards in a row — stages sit side by side while there is room.
• Vertical list — each stage on its own line.
manage.blocks.timeline.timeHelp:
Pick a date and time from the event schedule or enter your own moment.
A schedule date follows the event.
manage.blocks.timer.displayHelp:
Choose how the time to the selected date is shown.
• Numbers with labels — values placed side by side.
• Compact — a single line with the time.
• Tiles — each part in its own cell.
• Large accent — the largest unit stands out.
• Seconds dial — seconds in a ring, other values next to it.
• Rows — each unit on its own line.
• Poster — a large main number and smaller others.
• Bars — hours, minutes and seconds shown as bars.
• Scoreboard — numbers in contrasting cells.
• Ticker — large numbers with vertical dividers.
• Cascade — values on steps.
• Orbits — each value in its own circle.
• Mosaic — four values in a solid grid.
• Contrast band — all values on one colored band.
• Time rings — values inside circles showing elapsed time.
manage.blocks.visibility.help:
When the block is visible on the page.
• Always — with no extra conditions.
• Conditional — shown only for the selected event values.
If there are several conditions, all must be met.
manage.blocks.visibility.label: Block visibility
manage.blocks.visibility.note: The block appears only when all conditions are met.

• First — before standard and extra pages.
• After “Challenges” — before results.
• After “Results” — if results are shown for this event.
• After an extra page — right after it.

• Show — visible to those who can access the page.
• Hide — the page opens only by a direct link.

The part of the page address after /.
• Latin letters, digits and hyphens.
• Up to 128 characters.

A new address works after publishing; the old one then stops working.

manage.content.page.titleHelp:
Title of the extra page.
• Shown in the browser tab.
